MLYNARMOD-MLYNAR.title: Mlynar
MLYNARMOD-MLYNAR.description: A Kazimierz wanderer. Store Poise in the sheath. While the sword is drawn, each Poise increases attack damage by 10%. Entering the draw grants 1 Energy; leaving it clears Poise and draws 3 cards.
MLYNARMOD-MLYNAR.cardsModifierDescriptio: Mlynar's cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
mlynar_bottom: Put on bottom of draw pile
mlynar_top: Put on top of draw pile
mlynar_letter_exhaust: Exhaust 1 card; choose none to gain Poise
